title: Attributes
body:
Syntax: train <attribute|str|wis|con|int|dex|luk|per|wil|cc>

Description: All nine core attributes are trainable one point at a time for one training point per increase, including Perception, Willpower, and Chakra Control. Short forms (per, wil, cc) and full names including 'train chakra control' work. All attributes are capped at 75.

&CStrength&x - Increases your damage in combat: +1 to your basic attack's damage for every 4 points.
  &G[Active]&x

&CDexterity&x - Improves your reflexes: increases your Dodge Chance (see 'help combatstats'), feeds other combat stats, and grows your Stamina gain each level (+0.5/point above 10, uncapped).
  &G[Active]&x

&CIntelligence&x - Determines how much proficiency you gain each time you practice a skill, and is the majority share (75%) of how much Chakra you gain each level.
  &G[Active]&x

&CWisdom&x - More practice points each level (up to +6 bonus at maxed Wisdom, 9 total; base is 3). Also a minor (25%) share of your Chakra gain, alongside Intelligence.
  &G[Active]&x

&CLuck&x - Increases your Critical Chance, landing hits that deal 50% extra damage (see 'help combatstats').
  &G[Active]&x

&CConstitution&x - Increases how much max Health you gain each level: base 8 HP/level, plus +0.5 HP for every point above 10, with no cap of its own.
  &G[Active]&x

&CPerception&x - Expands Scan beyond the adjacent room along an open route: 1 room below 40 Perception, 2 rooms at 40-64, and 3 rooms at 65+. Never reveals invisible or camouflaged targets, hidden exits or blocked doors. Train with 'train per'.
  &G[Active and trainable]&x

&CWillpower&x - Your mental defense against ordinary Genjutsu. Each 2 points above 10 add 1% chance to resist a new Genjutsu status (up to 30%). Each 5 points above 10 add 1% per-second chance to break a Genjutsu status already on you (up to 13%). Can also resist or escape Illusion Walk; it never bypasses Mangekyo's special dimension/loop conditions. Train with 'train wil'.
  &G[Active and trainable]&x

&CChakra Control&x - Train with 'train cc' or 'train chakra control'. Each point trained above 10 immediately and permanently adds 10 maximum Chakra. Also discounts Genjutsu and Ninjutsu Chakra costs by up to 50%, and improves Chakra regeneration.
  &G[Active]&x

&D(See also: 'help combatstats', 'help scoresheet')&x

Date: 2026-08-17
